Getting Started > Installation and Building

Installation and Building

This page explains how to install the SA toolchain on your machine: preferably with the fully automatic installation bundle (a single zip that ships sa.exe, the top-level sla.exe, the standard library, and all official plugins), or, failing that, by building sci from source and installing each piece individually. The focus is on several known pitfalls in the Windows environment: the LLVM switch, PATH, NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath, and dumpbin.exe.

The Fully Automatic Installation Bundle (Recommended)

The repository provides a one-click Windows installation bundle: a single zip containing sa.exe, sla.exe as a top-level command, the std standard library, and all official plugins — ready to use once installed, with no need to build each piece from source.

Building the Installation Bundle

# 运行目录：sci 仓库根目录
powershell tools\package_windows.ps1                # 产出 dist\SCI-windows-x64-full.zip
powershell tools\package_windows.ps1 -Include3D     # 额外打包 3D 引擎子插件

The script builds sci and each plugin, collects the artifacts according to each plugin's sap.json manifest, and assembles a directory structure of bin\ (sa.exe, sla.exe, sla.dll), include\, std\, and plugins\<name>\, and generates a manifest file in the sa.bundle/1 format. By default sa_plugin_ts is excluded; sa_plugin_3dengines is bundled only with -Include3D. If llvm-dis/llvm-as cannot be found, the script warns — bc2sa's bitcode translation requires the LLVM tools to be installed separately. Other parameters: -Output <路径> changes the output location, and -SkipBuild skips the build and assembles the bundle directly.

One-Click Installation from the Bundle

# 命令行全自动安装（运行目录：sci 仓库根目录）
powershell tools\install_bundle_windows.ps1 -Bundle dist\SCI-windows-x64-full.zip

# 可选参数：
#   -NoPath               不修改用户 PATH
#   -EnablePluginDevMode  额外把 SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 写入用户环境
#   -InstallRoot / -PluginHome / -TimeoutSeconds   自定义安装位置与超时

The script first checks that bin\sa.exe, bin\sla.exe, and std are all present in the bundle, then:

  • installs the SA core into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\SCI\current;
  • writes each plugin, according to its sap.json, into %LOCALAPPDATA%\sa_plugins\installed\<name>\current (including the interface contract, assets, demos, and permission lock, automatically going through the sa plugin install --review review flow when something is missing);
  • adds bin to the user PATH, and sets the user-level environment variables SA_STD_DIR (pointing at the bundle's std) and SA_PLUGINS_HOME.

At the end it automatically runs sa --version and sla --version to verify. Both sa and sla are top-level commands, and a proper installation does not need SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1. If PATH was newly added by this installation, open a new terminal before verifying.

The Graphical Installer

tools\build_electron_installer_windows.ps1 first calls the packaging script to produce the bundle (you can reuse an existing zip with -SkipBundle), then uses electron-builder to package tools/electron-installer into a Windows graphical installer; internally it runs exactly the same install_bundle_windows.ps1 -Bundle … flow, which makes it suitable for distribution to users who do not use the command line.

Prerequisites

  • Zig 0.17.0 (sci's build.zig.zon declares minimum_zig_version = "0.17.0"; building with an older version will fail). On this machine it is installed into the user-level global PATH: D:\tools\zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0\zig.exe (some scripts default to D:\zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0\zig.exe, which can be overridden with the environment variable ZIG). Only newly opened terminals see the updated PATH.
  • LLVM 14 (needed when building sa.exe with the LLVM backend): LLVM-C.dll, LLVM-C.lib, and llvm-c/Core.h. Local paths that appear in the documentation are D:\LLVM-14.0.6 and C:\LLVM-14.
  • PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe): Windows terminal commands uniformly use it, as its compatibility is better than Windows PowerShell 5.1.

Building sci (the SA Compiler)

For Linux / quick verification the default switches suffice; on Windows, use the LLVM backend:

# 运行目录：sci 仓库根目录
# Linux / macOS / 通用
zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast

# Windows（启用 LLVM-C 后端）
zig build -Dllvm=true -Dllvm-include-dir=D:\LLVM-14.0.6\include ^
          -Dllvm-lib-dir=D:\LLVM-14.0.6\lib -Dllvm-lib-name=LLVM-C

The artifacts land in zig-out/bin/. When LLVM is enabled, the build also copies LLVM-C.dll into the output directory. Before running sa.exe, add LLVM's lib directory to PATH (for example C:\LLVM-14\lib), otherwise loading LLVM-C.dll will fail.

One-Click SA Installation from Source

When installing directly from source without the bundle, Windows provides an npm-style installation script that rebuilds + installs + registers PATH:

:: 运行目录：sci 仓库根目录；--user 免管理员权限
cmd /c tools\install.bat --user

The script copies sa.exe, LLVM-C.dll, and hubproxy.exe into a versioned directory (such as %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\SCI\0.0.4\bin\), creates the SCI\current junction, and adds SCI\current\bin to the user PATH. Optional environment variable overrides: ZIG, LLVM_INC, LLVM_LIB.

NoteIf you find that the installed sa.exe has become a stub build without LLVM linked in (about 10.93 MB instead of about 11.27 MB, with no LLVM-C.dll import in the PE), simply run the install.bat above once more to restore it end to end, with no need to copy files by hand.

Installing the SLA Plugin and the Top-Level sla Command

The SLA compiler is delivered as an external plugin and depends on an already installed SA. With the fully automatic bundle above it is already included in the package; to install it separately from source, run:

# 运行目录：sa_plugin_sla 仓库根目录
.\tools\install_windows.ps1

The script builds the plugin with zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast, installs the DLL via sa plugin install --dev, and copies the standalone sla.exe into SCI\current\bin — from then on sla is a top-level command, and you can use sla check / sla build-exe / sla test directly, without writing sa sla …. The script has installation timeout protection.

NoteThis source path installs in dev mode, and the host requires the SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 prefix; the plugins in the official installation bundle do not. The top-level sla.exe obtained either way is used in exactly the same way.

Manual method (Linux or the generic flow):

# 运行目录：sa_plugin_sla 仓库根目录
zig build
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa plugin install --dev <插件仓库绝对路径>

The build outputs are zig-out/lib/sap.json (the plugin manifest) and the dynamic library (libsla.so / the corresponding Windows DLL). Dev plugin commands all need the prefix SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1. If the SCI installer changed PATH, open a new terminal before verifying sa --version.

Windows Environment Notes

  • NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath: development sessions carry NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1 by default, and cmd.exe will refuse to resolve executables from the current directory (reporting "not recognized as an internal or external command" even when the file is right there in the current directory). Clear it before compiling or running the sci unit tests: $env:NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath = $null
  • dumpbin.exe: the plugin installation tests in zig build test depend on MSVC's dumpbin, which needs to be on PATH, for example $env:Path = "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.44.35207\bin\Hostx64\x64;" + $env:Path
  • Encoding: always handle text containing Chinese with explicit UTF-8 (such as Get-Content -Encoding UTF8 and Set-Content -Encoding UTF8); when output looks garbled, re-read it as UTF-8 to confirm before concluding the file is corrupted.
  • Demo reference artifacts: reference artifacts such as main.sa under demos are git-tracked files, so do not write batch compilation output next to the source directory; if you overwrite one by mistake, restore it with git checkout -- demos.

Next Steps

Once installed, go to Quick Start: Your First SLA Program to run through the complete flow.
